_note: Song Engine v2 harmonic plan (docs/song-engine-v2-prd.md R6): which chords each section plays, as a rule over the chosen progression's degrees. Pure data, resolved by lib/songPlan.ts; the plan is a pure function of (progression, section). Rules: `progression` = the progression stretched to `bars` bars (a 3-chord loop holds its last chord); `pattern` = picks from the progression by index (`pick`, cycled over `bars`); `byChorusStart` = degrees chosen by the progression's first chord (`map`), so the section sets up the Chorus; `darkest` = the first `pairs` entry whose chords are both in the progression, cycled by `pick` over `bars`, else `fallback`; `fixed` = these degrees. `label` starts the card's plan line ("Climb: IV-V"). The Solo has no rule: the lead engine plays over the progression.

intro.label: Chorus opener
intro.why: The Chorus's first two chords: the intro sets up the hook

verse.label: Progression, sparser
verse.why: The progression's own chords, in a sparser palm-muted rhythm (owner call, 2026-09-30)

prechorus.label: Climb
prechorus.why: A climb into the Chorus's first chord: IV–V into I or vi; vi–V into IV; vi–IV into V

chorus.label: Chords
chorus.why: The chosen progression: the song's hook

breakdown.label: Darkest two
breakdown.why: The progression's darkest two chords (vi first), else a tonic pedal
